item: FP arms v2 (C-00 25.09): FP-only arm mesh, same PlayerRig v002 skeleton and FP clips; TP body unchanged

fbx.exporter: player_base_v002 settings (-Z fwd, Y up, FBX units, no leaf bones, all bones, tangent space, path_mode STRIP)

textures.orm: textures/AP022_fparms_orm_4k.png (R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic = AP-006 convention)
textures.skins: roll = primary, roll fold = secondary, cords + stitches = accent, kote leather = that skin's TP kote sample (AP-006 texture-manifest-v003)

design.roll: haori sleeve rolled 3.5 cm above the elbow joint, 4.0 cm high, <= +0.95 cm over the skin, crimson double tasuki cord + flat knot on the lateral face; the arm ends in a closed cap inside the roll
design.kote: 20.2 cm (3.5 cm below the elbow -> 1.8 cm above the wrist joint), 3 segments, 3 double-cord rows, wall 3.2 mm, <= 5.8 mm over the skin
design.hands: palm wrap to the MCP knuckles (1.8 mm offset, thumb loop), 10 bare fingers (8 sides, >= 3 loops per phalanx), nails in albedo

acceptance_replicated.method: 05-blender/scripts/AP022-fparms-measure-v001.py: FP rest clip f0, fp_camera + FpCameraOffsets on the anchor, fpView v4 (S-02 6f7c3802) rig shift, S-06 two-bone IK + elbow poles (97a17634), clavicle Front-Back clamp 8 deg (calibrated on S-06 f19 old-mesh numbers: ar_1 17.2 / 18.0, ar_2 14.3 / 14.2, smg_1 11.4 / 11.1 %), 1920x1080, 58.7 deg vertical, arms only

integration_notes: FirstPersonArms swaps Player_Body_LOD0.sharedMesh for the FP mesh: this mesh has its own bone array / bindposes (same names, same rest) -> remap bone indices by name to the body renderer's bones, or instantiate this FBX as the FP model with the player avatar.
Material: M_Player_FPArms (URP Lit) with these maps; SyncSkin should swap the albedo per skin (skin1/2/3 files) instead of copying the TP albedo block.

smg_2 has no ArtAnimatorBuilder.FpCameraOffsets entry (falls back to 0,0,0) while its FP set is the smg_1 clips authored with (-0.04,-0.06,0); smg_2 also has no left-hand IK point (no AP022_fp_smg_2_idle_aim row).
f19 minCam counted every vertex of the old arms mesh (it keeps all body vertices, only triangles were dropped): ar_2 1.1 cm was a torso vertex. The new mesh has no unused vertices.

FP clip finger poses were authored for the old mitten hands: with separated fingers the left fingertips rise ~2-3 cm above the handguard and the right fingers read loose at the trigger guard (clip follow-up, outside this mesh-only job).

art_verdict.applied_after_verdict: SHOULD/follow-up 2: cap albedo = shadowed inner-kimono tone, radial pinch removed; palm grime stronger; thumb-loop tab softened (texture only, geometry and numbers unchanged)
open: clip finger curls per weapon grip (mitten-era poses) - required before a release build; AP-022 clip owner, C-00 schedules
kote damp strip + skin smoothness under Look B: S-06 Unity check
wear asymmetry / kote ulnar scuffs stronger: v3 texture pass
